context: A chef plans a winter festival menu
purpose: Teach: 刀/商人/平安/伝承/作物/納豆/薬局/ツリー

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 冬フェア、平安期のレシピも一品入れよか。
lines.en: Winter fair — should we slip in a Heian-era recipe too?
lines.style: Upbeat, generous Kansai lilt. Leaning forward with enthusiasm. Casual question-tone that invites collaboration, not debate. Warm energy carrying the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいですね。地域の作物と納豆の和え物、合いそう。
lines.en: That sounds perfect. Local vegetables with natto — they'd go really well together.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost soft. Slight pause before speaking, like she's picturing it as she talks. Genuine warmth. Quiet confidence in the pairing.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 昔ながらの商人町を彷彿させる装飾も、ええな。
lines.en: Yeah, and decor that brings back that old merchant-town feeling — that'd work beautifully.
lines.style: Knowing enthusiasm. Light emphasis on 「ええな」 equivalent — the small nod of someone recognizing a good idea. Kansai warmth without performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 刀の装飾レプリカ、地元伝承と絡めて。
lines.en: Sword-replica decorations woven into the local legends — that could really tie it together.
lines.style: Bright and engaged. Building on his idea with her own, no hesitation. Clear, conversational pace. The lightness of someone seeing the vision come together.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 近くの薬局からも、ハーブ仕入れさせてもらおか。
lines.en: We could ask the pharmacy nearby to supply the herbs too.
lines.style: Practical and grounded. Kansai directness softened by partnership. Natural problem-solving tone, matter-of-fact but not hurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店先のツリー、装飾、こだわって飾りますね。
lines.en: The storefront tree — we'll make sure every decoration really shines.
lines.style: Warm, gentle resolve. Slight lift on 「こだわって」 — the care she's committing to. Soft close, almost tender. The kind of promise made quietly to someone she trusts.
